assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire-safety and engineering constraints are not present in the public package and must be confirmed before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: All spatial proposals remain conceptual; no FAR, height, road-redline, ownership or engineering approval is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY has not yet been released; the maintainer-defined provisional boundary is used only for generation, display and temporary recalculation.
assumptions.impact: Content review remains possible, but all area-based metrics and location drawings must be recalculated when official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Official polygons for 众智园, AI原点社区 and 大钟寺 have not yet been released; current key-area polygons are provisional.
assumptions.impact: Key-area layouts are design hypotheses and must be reprojected/recalculated against official polygons.

assumptions.statement: The 'Civic Handshake' mandate/receipt framework is a design and governance proposal, not an assertion that existing law already recognizes a new AI legal status or delegated civic authority.
assumptions.impact: Any implementation would require legal, administrative, cybersecurity, accessibility and service-owner review. The proposal deliberately treats the human/institution as the accountable principal.

assumptions.statement: The proposal assumes future public services can expose auditable agent-readable interfaces and revocable credentials without requiring a single vendor or model.
assumptions.impact: Architecture remains vendor-neutral; specific identity, signature, payment or credential technologies are deliberately left open.

assumptions.statement: No resident trial, service-provider integration, public-sector authorization, field measurement or live agent transaction was conducted for this proposal.
assumptions.impact: All scenario performance claims are design targets or tabletop logic only; no operational effectiveness is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Port locations, public-space footprints, corridor width and building footprints are conceptual parameters used to make the spatial logic visible and computable.
assumptions.impact: These parameters are not statutory standards and may change after official geometry and professional surveys are available.
